title: Proposal: working together on CDKL5 deficiency disorder research

sentences.text: A proposal to work together on research into CDKL5 deficiency disorder.
We are writing to the International Foundation for CDKL5 Research because you support families living with CDKL5 deficiency disorder.
We have not met yet, and we would value your guidance.
Published work links the disorder to loss of function, though some variants appear to cause only a partial loss.
Your Connect CDKL5 platform and the recruiting International CDKL5 Clinical Research Network already gather information on the condition.
The International CDKL5 Registry is listed as suspended, and a natural history study of Rett syndrome and related disorders has completed.
A phase 3 ganaxolone study has completed, a phase 3 ganaxolone trial in very young children is not yet recruiting, and a phase 3 ZX008 study is active but not recruiting.
A soticlestat study was terminated, and no result from the fenfluramine trial is recorded in the atlas.
We would propose a study on [research question about CDKL5 deficiency disorder], shaped with your community from the start.
Its design, sites and funding are still to be settled: [study details].

sections.heading: What we would ask of you

sentences.text: Would you be open to discussing this idea with us?
If so, we would like to learn how Connect CDKL5 or your community might take part, always with proper consent and ethics approval.
We are not asking for any personal information about patients or families.
If this is of interest, could we arrange a short call at a time that suits you?
